items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: John had a man playing trumpet, he alternated by the name of Wooden Joe.

ctx.x: Yeah, but I never did know his right name. His full name. Did you know? And he had a, no I forgot, but I could get it. I'd love to know his right name. Everybody says he would.

And he had a drummer by the name of Albert Jow. You heard of him? Oh yeah. I knew him. Then we had all the way through, we had uh, uh, Poirier, Allison Poirier on piano. He stayed with Isaiah Morgan. And when I left Morgan, I joined the John Casimir band. The John Casimir, I started playing at Claiborne and Tulane Avenue. John had a man playing trumpet, he alternated by the name of Wooden Joe. Oh yeah. Uh huh. And that's who else John had. John had, I can't, I don't know the rest of this man's name. He had…
Juniors? Never heard of him. You know him, Nick? Yeah, I've heard of him because I interviewed John.
